title: World atlas
subtitle: Choose a path from the whole world

anchorAudit.rationale: Re-audited the final bright-v4 pixels zone by zone, preserving four disjoint destination districts and retaining 107 independently pointable landscape, building, furniture, transit, park and garden objects or parts.
